annotations.title: Read Scripture word for word from a stored text

description: Read the Bible word for word from a stored text, never from memory. Modes: passage, context, search, compare, original_words, cross_references, verify, translations, which_translation, languages, explained. Use when you know the reference or the words. Example: {mode:"passage", reference:"John 3:16"}. Full guide: living-bread://tools/read_scripture. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

include_original.description: For compare. Add Hebrew or Greek.

include_text.description: For cross_references. Read each linked passage.

mode.description: The kind of answer. Leave out for a guide to the modes.

need.description: For which_translation: what the reader needs.

parallel.description: For search. Translation id beside each verse.

query.description: For search: words that must all appear ("mercy truth"), or an exact phrase in double quotes.

quote.description: For verify: the exact words to check, as they would be quoted.

reference.description: Book, chapter and optional verse or range as a reader writes it: "John 3:16", "Psalm 23", "1 Cor 13:4-7".

strong.description: For original_words. Strong's number, e.g. G25.

translations.description: For compare. Translation ids to compare.

name: read_scripture
title: Read Scripture word for word from a stored text
